settings.page.title: Settings
settings.general.workspaceDescription: Simplify project management by organizing projects into workspaces.
settings.general.tasksOrdered: Tasks are ordered by Task ID
settings.general.tasksRandom: Tasks are chosen with uniform random
settings.general.uncertaintyDescription: Tasks are chosen according to model uncertainty score (active learning mode).
settings.annotation.instructionsDesc1: Write instructions to help users complete labeling tasks.
settings.annotation.instructionsDesc2: The instruction field supports HTML markup and it allows use of images, iframes (pdf).
settings.annotation.usePredictionsDesc: Enable and select which set of predictions to use for prelabeling.
settings.annotation.selectPredictionOrMo: Select which predictions or which model you want to use:
settings.model.title: Model
settings.model.connectDesc: Connect a machine learning model to generate live predictions for your project. Compare predictions, accelerate labeling with automatic prelabeling, and direct your team to the most impactful tasks through active learning.
settings.model.configureStepsIntro: A connected model has been detected! If you wish to fetch predictions from this model, please follow these steps:
settings.model.step3: 3. Click on Batch predictions from the Actions menu.
settings.model.prelabelingHint: If you want to use the model predictions for prelabeling, please configure this in the
settings.model.startTraining: Start model training on annotation submission
settings.model.startTrainingDesc: This option will send a request to /train with information about annotations. You can use this to enable an Active Learning loop. You can also manually start training through model menu in its card.
settings.model.learnMoreAria: Learn more about machine learning models (opens in new window)
settings.predictions.title: Predictions
settings.predictions.listDesc: List of predictions available in the project. Each card is associated with a separate model version. To learn about how to import predictions,
settings.predictions.emptyDesc: Upload predictions to automatically prelabel your data and speed up annotation. Import predictions from multiple model versions to compare their performance, or connect live models from the Model page to generate predictions on demand.
settings.predictions.learnMoreAria: Learn more about predictions (opens in new window)
settings.storage.title: Cloud Storage
settings.storage.desc: Use cloud or database storage as the source for your labeling tasks or the target of your completed annotations.
settings.storage.learnMoreAria: Learn more about cloud storage (opens in new window)
settings.webhooks.title: Webhooks
settings.webhooks.desc: Setup integrations that subscribe to certain events using Webhooks. When an event is triggered, Label Studio sends an HTTP POST request to the configured webhook URL.
settings.webhooks.contactAdmin: Contact your administrator to create Webhooks
settings.webhooks.learnMoreAria: Learn more about webhooks (opens in new window)
settings.danger.title: Danger Zone
settings.danger.desc: Perform these actions at your own risk. Actions you take on this page can't be reverted. Make sure your data is backed up.
settings.danger.resetCacheHelp: Reset Cache may help in cases like if you are unable to modify the labeling configuration due to validation errors concerning existing labels, but you are confident that the labels don't exist. You can use this action to reset the cache and try again.
settings.danger.dropTabsHelp: If the Data Manager is not loading, dropping all Data Manager tabs can help.
settings.danger.deleteProjectHelp: Deleting a project removes all tasks, annotations, and project data from the database.
settings.danger.confirmInput: To proceed, type "{{word}}" in the field below:
settings.danger.confirmReset: You are about to reset the cache for {{projectTitle}}. This action cannot be undone.
settings.danger.confirmTabs: You are about to drop all tabs for {{projectTitle}}. This action cannot be undone.
settings.danger.confirmProject: You are about to delete the project {{projectTitle}}. This action cannot be undone.
